topic: Asking the Airline Desk for Wheelchair Help for Grandma

script.title: AT THE AIRLINE DESK
script.scene_zh: 航空公司櫃台 · 申請輪椅協助
script.story_hook: Grandma holds a sign; the agent smiles.
script.intro_zh: 阿嬤舉著手寫小牌，櫃台見了直點頭。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the airline desk scene. Listen for requests and airport phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到航空公司櫃台這一幕。留意請求與機場常用說法。
script.outro: And that's one grandma flying with a full team. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一位長輩身後，多了整整一個團隊。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat the lines, one by one.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們逐句跟讀，一句一句來。
script.title_quote: she beat me at rummy every single time
script.char_a_description: a tall young man in his early twenties with tousled dirty-blond hair, light freckles, an olive green bomber jacket over a grey hoodie, a small backpack on one shoulder, and a lean build
script.char_b_description: a composed woman in her fifties with dark hair in a tight low chignon, gold hoop earrings, a bright red silk scarf at the collar of her navy airline blazer, and an average build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, this may sound odd, but I need help.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðɪs meɪ ˈsaʊnd ˈɑd bʌt aɪ ˈnid ˈhɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，聽起來可能有點怪，但我們需要幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're at the right desk, go ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ æt ðə ˈraɪt ˈdɛsk ˈɡoʊ əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 您算找對人了，請說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See that lady at gate eleven? My grandma.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðæt ˈleɪdi æt ɡeɪt ɪˈlɛvən maɪ ˈɡɹænmɑ/
dialogue.zh: 看見十一號登機口那邊的太太了嗎？那是我阿嬤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one holding the handwritten sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði wʌn ˈhoʊldɪŋ ðə ˈhændˌrɪtən saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那位舉著手寫小牌的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! It says 'help her, she tires fast.'
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ˈsɛz ˈhɛlp hɚ ʃi ˈtaɪɹz ˈfæst/
dialogue.zh: 對！上面寫：幫幫她，她很容易累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the sweetest thing I've seen all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈswitəst θɪŋ aɪv sin ɔl wik/
dialogue.zh: 這是我這整個星期看過最暖心的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She beat me at rummy every single time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi bit mi æt ˈɹʌmi ˈɛvɹi ˈsɪŋɡəl taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 她玩拉米牌從未輸給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A champion! So, what does she need today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtʃæmpiən soʊ wʌt dʌz ʃi nid təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 原來是冠軍啊！那，今天需要什麼協助？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walking hurts her knees, a wheelchair would help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔkɪŋ hɝts hɚ niz ə ˈwidʒɛɹˌtʃɛɹ wʊd hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 走路很傷她的膝蓋，有一台輪椅會好很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally, and here's the good news: it's free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli ænd hɪɹz ðə ɡʊd nuz ɪts fri/
dialogue.zh: 完全該幫，而且好消息：這是免費服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free? Um, do I pay anything at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ʌm du aɪ peɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 免費？嗯，總共不用花半毛錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not one cent, airlines owe this to riders.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt wʌn sɛnt ˈɛɚˌlaɪnz oʊ ðɪs tə ˈɹaɪdɚz/
dialogue.zh: 一毛都不用，這是航空公司該做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, relief number one done. Now details.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ rɪˈlif ˈnʌmbɚ wʌn dʌn naʊ dɪˈteɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 好，第一個擔心解決了。接著是細節。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ask away, I love organized travelers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ æsk əˈweɪ aɪ lʌv ˈɔɾɡəˌnaɪzənd ˈtɹævələɹz/
dialogue.zh: 請盡量問，我喜歡有條理的旅客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the wheelchair wait at the gate or curbside?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈwidʒɛɹˌtʃɛɹ weɪt æt ðə ɡeɪt ɔɹ ˈkɝːbˌsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 輪椅是在登機口等，還是在路邊等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Curbside first, she rides to the door inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɝːbˌsaɪd fɝst ʃi raɪdz tə ðə dɔɹ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 先到路邊接她，再把她送進裡面那扇門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And after Tulsa? She has a return Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈæftɚ ˈtʌlsə ʃi hæz ə ɹɪˈtɝn ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 從圖爾薩回來呢？她週日要搭回程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same help, just tell the desk on arrival.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm hɛlp dʒʌst tɛl ðə dɛsk ɑn əˈɹaɪvəl/
dialogue.zh: 抵達時跟櫃台說一聲，就有同樣的服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's one twist, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz wʌn twɪst ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 其實，還有個小轉折。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, twists are my second middle name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɑn twɪstz ɑɹ maɪ ˈsɛkənd ˈmɪdəl neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 說吧，處理突發狀況正是我的專長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She flies with her walker too, the metal one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi flaɪz wɪð hɚ ˈwɔkɚ tu ðə ˈmɛɾəl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 她還會帶助行器一起搭機，金屬那台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that's easy, we gate-check walkers for free.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ˈizi wi ˈɡeɪt ˌtʃɛk ˈwɔkɚz fɚ fri/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那很簡單，助行器免費在登機口託運。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It folds? Good, space is tight today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt foʊldz ɡʊd speɪs ɪz taɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 能收摺嗎？那就好，今天空間很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Folds like a lawn chair, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊldz laɪk ə lɔn tʃɛɹ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，收起來就像張庭園椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, she'd like that comparison a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ʃɪd laɪk ðæt kəmˈpɛɹəsən ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，她一定很喜歡這個比喻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, seat preference? She'd want the aisle.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ sit ˈpɛfɚəns ʃɪd wɑnt ði aɪl/
dialogue.zh: 說到位子，她大概想要走道席吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Aisle, and if possible near the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl ænd ɪf ˈpɑsəbl nɪɹ ði fɹʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 對！走道席，如果可以的話，靠前一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look... row two aisle, all yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛt mi ˈlʊk roʊ tu ˈaɪl ɔl jʊɹz/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……第二排走道席，就給她囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No way, that's the fastest exit seat ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈweɪ ðæts ðə ˈfæstəst ˈɛɡzɪt sit ˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不是吧，那可是進出最快的座位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Special care seats, we keep some open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspɛʃəl kɛɹ sits wi kip sʌm ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 這是特殊照護席，我們都會留幾張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're an angel, a navy blazer angel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ən ˈeɪndʒəl ə ˈnævi ˈbleɪzɚ ˈeɪndʒəl/
dialogue.zh: 你根本是天使，一位深藍外套的天使。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, framed! Now, her return, does it connect?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ freɪmd naʊ hɚ ɹɪˈtɝn dʌz ɪt kəˈnɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這句我要裱起來！她回程需要轉機吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Denver, forty minutes, um, she worries me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɛnvɚ ˈfɔɹti ˈmɪnɪts ʌm ʃi ˈwɝiz mi/
dialogue.zh: 丹佛，只留四十分鐘，嗯，她讓我擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll send a cart to meet her flight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil sɛnd ə ˈkɑɹt tə ˈmit hɚ ˈflaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們會派接駁車在轉機口等她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cart at both ends of the layover?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɑɹt æt boʊθ ɛndz əv ðə ˈleɪˌoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 中停的兩頭都會安排接駁？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both ends, plus her bag moves too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈboʊθ ˈɛndz plʌs hɚ bæɡ muvz tu/
dialogue.zh: 兩頭都管，行李也會一起送過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You thought of everything, I'm almost jealous.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɔt əv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ aɪm ˈɔlmoʊst ˈdʒɛləs/
dialogue.zh: 你什麼都想到了，我幾乎要吃醋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, one favor for me then.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wʌn ˈfeɪvɚ fɚ mi ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那，請你也幫我一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything at all, name it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniθɪŋ ət ɔl neɪm ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 請說，樣樣都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her the desk says hi to the champion.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɚ ðə dɛsk sɛz haɪ tə ðə ˈtʃæmpiən/
dialogue.zh: 請轉告她，這個櫃台向冠軍致意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, that's all? She'll glow for a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts ˈɔl ʃil ɡlo fɚ ə ˈwik/
dialogue.zh: 哈，就這樣嗎？她會開心發光一整週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next, boarding: she goes before everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ˈbɔɹdɪŋ ʃi ɡoʊz bɪˈfɔɹ ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 接下來是登機，她會比大家先上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pre-boarding, um, does she need to rush?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɹi ˈbɔɹdɪŋ ʌm dʌz ʃi nid tə ɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 提前登機，嗯，她需要趕時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, we wait until she's settled.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹʌʃ wi weɪt ənˈtɪl ʃɪz ˈsɛɾəld/
dialogue.zh: 不用趕，我們會等她坐穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That removes a giant worry, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt rɪˈmuvz ə ˈdʒaɪənt ˈwɝi θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 那塊大石頭終於落地了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Here's her boarding pass, and a stub.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm hɪɚz hɚ ˈbɔɹdɪŋ pæs ænd ə stʌb/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。這是她的登機證，這張是小票根。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the little slip for, hmm?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ðə ˈlɪɾəl slɪp fɔɹ həm/
dialogue.zh: 這張小票根是做什麼用的呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Assistance ID, show it at any desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈsɪstəns aɪˈdi ʃoʊ ɪt æt ˈɛni dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 這是協助識別單，任何櫃台出示就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart, she loses paper, this saves the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ʃi ˈluzəz ˈpeɪpɚ ðɪs seɪvz ðə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，她常弄丟紙本，這張能救場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandma's all set? Anything else on the list?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɹænmɑz ɔl sɛt ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls ɑn ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 阿嬤這邊都妥當了？清單上還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually yes, um, can I sit near her?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli jɛs ʌm kæn aɪ sɪt nɪɹ hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 其實還有，嗯，我能坐在她旁邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're on the same flight, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɑn ðə ˈseɪm ˈflaɪt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你們搭同一班，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same flight, my seat's twelve, she's at two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪm ˈflaɪt maɪ sits twɛlv ʃɪz æt ˈtu/
dialogue.zh: 同一班，我的位子十二排，她在二排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One swap coming, row two beside the champ.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn swɑp ˈkʌmɪŋ roʊ tu bɪˈsaɪd ðə tʃæmp/
dialogue.zh: 我幫你換到第二排，冠軍的鄰座。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You really did think of everything, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɹɪli dɪd θɪnk əv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 你真的連這都替我想到了，啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my favorite part of this counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt pɑɹt əv ðɪs ˈkaʊɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡的，就是在這個櫃台幫到人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll hear about this, every mile home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃil hɪɹ əˈbaʊt ðɪs ˈɛvɹi maɪl hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 回家的每一哩，她都會唸起這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a safe flight, you two.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ˈseɪf ˈflaɪt ju ˈtu/
dialogue.zh: 祝你們兩個一路平安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, truly. Coffee near the gate, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ˈtɹuli ˈkɔfi nɪɹ ðə ɡeɪt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 真的謝謝。登機口附近有賣咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next left, and tell the champ we're ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛks lɛft ænd tɛl ðə tʃæmp wɪɹ ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 往下個路口左轉。順便告訴冠軍，我們準備好了。

script.youtube_title_en: "She Beat Me at Rummy Every Single Time" — Wheelchair Help for Grandma
script.youtube_description:
「她玩拉米牌從未輸給我」——阿嬤舉著手寫的小牌在登機口等，孫子走向航空公司櫃台，為她申請輪椅協助。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在機場登機櫃檯前。

你會聽到：開口請求協助的第一句怎麼說；輪椅該在路邊等、還是登機口等；助行器怎麼免費託運；中停轉機時接駁怎麼銜接；走道席、提前登機、協助識別單這些細節的問法；還有怎麼用一句話謝謝一位素昧平生的地勤。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現機場裡的真實語感：um、hmm、no way、okay。聽完你就會用：What does she need today?、it's free、Pre-boarding、Show it at any desk。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"She beat me at rummy every single time" — Grandma waits at the gate holding a handwritten sign, and her grandson walks up to the airline desk to arrange wheelchair help. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a busy airport check-in counter.

You will hear: the first sentence for asking help; choosing curbside or gate pickup; gate-checking a metal walker for free; bridging a tight Denver connection with carts at both ends; asking for an aisle seat, pre-boarding, and the little assistance ID slip; plus how to thank a stranger in uniform with one warm line.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real airport small talk: um, hmm, no way, okay. By the end you'll own phrases like What does she need today?, It's free, and Show it at any desk.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
陪同長輩搭飛機，她的膝蓋走不完整個航廈，輪椅服務要怎麼開口申請？免費嗎？助行器收哪裡？中停轉機那四十分鐘誰來接她？

這一集帶大家走進航空公司登機櫃台，從請求輪椅、確認免費服務，一路聽到路邊與登機口的接駁分工、託運助行器、轉機安排、走道席與提前登機，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🦽 開口請求：Walking hurts her knees, a wheelchair would help.
💳 免費確認：Free? Um, do I pay anything at all?
🔁 轉機安排：Denver, forty minutes, um, she worries me.
💺 座位調整：Yes! Aisle, and if possible near the front.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、hmm、okay 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟機場貼心的請求走一遍，下次陪家人出遠門，英文自己會開口。

願每一次為在乎的人開口，都有溫柔的人接住。
